[[File:Fanlanden map.jpg|140px|left|link=The seat of power]]
'''[[The seat of power]]''' bears three names and no verdict: ''Ederhamn'' in the Chronicle, ''Elvestad'' in the Songs, ''Ederstad'' in the burned fragments. No one can say why an inland city is named a haven — and a children's rhyme counts ''…to Elvestad, where the eleventh prayed.''
